apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

configurationRef.description: A reference to the Configuration CR that holds all the needed configuration for this resource. OASGen Provider added this field automatically.

namespace.description: Namespace of the referenced Configuration CR. If not provided, the same namespace will be used.

description.description: Problem description - sent as the request's first comment (comment.body).

kind.description: Request kind, set in the "Request kind" custom field (mapped to its tag value at install time). Bug for incident escalations, FeatureRequest otherwise.

krateo_reference.description: Correlation token - unique per request (e.g. the CR's metadata.uid). Stored in the "Krateo reference" custom ticket field and used to find the request again. Changing it files a NEW request. While empty the CR is held and nothing is filed.

priority.description: Requested priority. Applied by Zendesk only when the Priority field is editable by end users; otherwise Zendesk discards it.

lastTransitionTime.description: LastTransitionTime is the last time this condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: A Message containing details about this condition's last transition from one status to another, if any.

reason.description: A Reason for this condition's last transition from one status to another.

status.description: Status of this condition; is it currently True, False, or Unknown?

type.description: Type of this condition. At most one of each condition type may apply to a resource at any point in time.

html_url.description: The request's end-user web page (<instance>/hc/requests/<id>), for "Open in Zendesk".

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the metadata.generation the controller last reconciled.

priority.description: Current priority (agents may change it after creation).

status.description: new, open, pending, hold, solved or closed.
